metadata.title: The D-Score Snapshot Alignment Theorem: A Delay-Variance Budget for Asynchronous Biodiversity Indicators
metadata.description: A model-scoped theorem for temporal coherence in weighted biodiversity snapshots. Six frozen Lean theorems are independently audited with zero proof holes. The paper does not claim empirical biodiversity validation, universal timing rules, or literature priority.
metadata.notes: The release includes the final paper, deterministic 21-check suite, pinned Lean environment, six-theorem zero-sorry audit, provenance, and exact checksums. It is a standalone working-corpus result, not an Intelligence Bound spine addition, peer acceptance, or empirical validation.
